title: State
description: pixelbar/<target>/state, retained. What the room is doing; screens' media and presence rules read it.

media.description: What the media player is doing: playing, paused or off. Screens can follow it.

presence.description: Whether someone is in the room. Screens can follow it.

sleep.description: Older form of screen: "sleep". Shows the screen called sleep, if the layout has one.

screen.description: Show this screen whatever the rules say. auto (the default) follows the rules.
